title: Automated onboarding + gated release for embeddings + reranker profile publishing
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Create an end-to-end automated onboarding pipeline for embedding and reranker models that publishes validated performance profiles and supports gated rollouts. Goals: 1) Reduce manual steps for pinning profile artifacts, 2) enforce deterministic admission criteria (latency/quality/cost), 3) publish signed profile bundles to the catalog and trigger canary rollouts with automatic rollback on regression. This ticket encompasses CI harness work, stability gate implementation, telemetry events, and Console integration for profile publishing and rollout status.
acceptance_criteria: CI job that runs model candidate through golden prompt suite and records recall/precision/rr@10 and latency p50/p95/p99
Automated pin artifact creation with deterministic manifest (hashes + env metadata) and upload to profile-catalog with signature
Gating rules implemented: quality regression <1.5% absolute or <5% relative, latency p95 <= baseline + 30ms, token-cost delta < +8%
Console shows published profile with provenance, and rollout canary controller can target 5/25/100% phases with health checks
Automated rollback when quality regressions observed in canary or when SLA error rate > 0.5%
Documentation and runbook for on-call and SEs updated in Confluence
updates: 2026-03-10 - Scoped: agreed gating thresholds with PM (Alyssa Chen) and Research (Jorge Mendes); prioritized golden prompt set (150 examples across search/rerank).

2026-03-11 - Prototype CI: added baseline runner in 'onboard-ci' that executes quantized variants on x86 + a100 and emits metrics to QA bucket (s3://redwood-onboard/ci). Initial run shows 12ms p95 improvement on quantized-small but 1.8% MRR drop on reranker guard set.

2026-03-12 - Design feedback: Console UX team (Kate Liu) requested an explicit provenance panel; added to schema for profile metadata. Decided to make 'latency baseline' per-arch to avoid false regressions across hardware.

2026-03-12 - Code PR: opened github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/PR#647 implementing manifest signer and upload step; seeking review from Marco and Dan. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/pull/647

2026-03-12 - Blocker noted: existing catalog importer rejects profiles missing 'kv-cache-compat' flag. Added temporary shim in CI to infer compat from model cfg; follow-up to remove shim in ENG-97680.

Next steps: finalize gating rule config, wire telemetry events to Console (profile.publish, profile.rollout.start, profile.rollout.health), and run 3 candidate model on private-dedicated cluster canary by 2026-03-20.
engineering_notes: Prefer per-arch baselines: separate latency and kernel profiles for -a100, -t4, and -cpu-quantized
Golden prompt suite aims to balance retrieval-like long-context vs short-pair classification for reranker sensitivity
Trade-off: lowering latency threshold increases false negatives for high-quality candidates; agreed to conservative default and allow per-customer overrides
Telemetry: emit sampling IDs to correlate candidate-run results with production rollout metrics (use tag 'onboard_candidate_id')
